title: Breadth-first branches (Cytoscape.js)
description: Cytoscape computes a breadth-first layout and breadth-first traversal of an original directed network. Highlight depth reveals the discovered layers.
description_ko: Cytoscape가 직접 만든 방향 그래프를 너비 우선으로 배치하고 탐색해요. Highlight depth로 발견한 층을 차례로 밝혀요.
prompt: Breadth-first branches. Make the algorithm visible and let the controls change its input.
summary: Breadth-first branches. Change the controls to explore the actual algorithm.
